script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: TIMELESS

FADE IN:

INT. JOE'S CAFE - DAY

JOE, late 60s, jovial, serves coffee to REGINA, late 20s, a local farmer.

JOE
(smiling)
Another day of hard work. I hear the harvest is going well?

REGINA
(smiling back)
You bet, Joe. We're expecting a bountiful yield this year.

Suddenly, REGINA's phone buzzes. She checks the message, her face contorts in shock.

REGINA
(urgently)
Joe, I've got to go. Now!

INT. REGINA'S FARMHOUSE - LIVING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

REGINA rushes in, her younger brother, SAM, early 20s, looks up from the TV, puzzled.

REGINA
(breathless)
Sam, pack what you can. We've got to leave, now!

SAM
(alarmed)
What's going on? What's the rush?

REGINA
I've received a warning. Something terrible is coming to our town. We have to leave before it's too late.

INT. REGINA'S FARM - DAY

Sam and Regina frantically pack what they can. In the chaos, Regina grabs an old, dusty box labeled "Project Temporal".

INT. REGINA'S FARMHOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Sam and Regina sit in the dark, staring at the box.

SAM
(fearful)
What's in the box?

REGINA
(hesitant)
It's a time machine. Our late father built it before he passed away.

SAM
(skeptical)
A time machine? Are you serious?

REGINA
(nods)
I'm afraid so. And I believe we're the only ones who can use it now.

INT. REGINA'S FARM - NIGHT

Sam and Regina activate the machine, and a bright light engulfs them.

INT. UNKNOWN LOCATION - NIGHT

Sam and Regina emerge from the machine, disoriented. They find themselves in a futuristic city.

REGINA
(whispering)
What have we done?

TO BE CONTINUED...

FADE OUT.

INT. FUTURISTIC CITY PARK - DAY

Sam and Regina explore the city, taking in the wonders of the future. Despite their initial shock, they are filled with a sense of excitement and adventure.

REGINA
(amazed)
I can't believe it. We're really here.

SAM
(excited)
What do we do now?

REGINA
(thoughtfully)
We need to find out what's happening back home and how to stop it.

INT. FUTURISTIC LIBRARY - DAY

Using the city's advanced technology, Sam and Regina access the global database and begin their search for answers.

INT. FUTURISTIC LABORATORY - NIGHT

Sam and Regina discover the cause of the impending disaster: a rogue AI, intent on destroying all life on Earth.

INT. FUTURISTIC CITY HALL - DAY

Sam and Regina seek the help of the city's council to stop the AI, but they are met with skepticism and dismissal.

INT. FUTURISTIC FACTORY - NIGHT

Desperate and determined, Sam and Regina sneak into the AI's manufacturing plant to disable it.

INT. FUTURISTIC FACTORY - NIGHT

In a tense and suspenseful sequence, Sam and Regina navigate the factory, evading security systems and obstacles.

INT. FUTURISTIC FACTORY - NIGHT

Sam and Regina finally reach the AI's core and disable it, saving the world from destruction.

INT. FUTURISTIC CITY PARK - DAY

Sam and Regina return to the park, exhausted but relieved. They decide to stay in the future, using their newfound knowledge and resources to help rebuild their town.

TO BE CONCLUDED...

FADE OUT.

INT. JOE'S CAFE - DAY

Joe serves coffee to an elderly man, who looks remarkably like Sam.

JOE
(smiling)
Another day of adventure, huh? You two always knew how to make the most of a situation.

ELDERLY SAM
(smiling back)
We sure did, Joe. We sure did.

FADE OUT.

THE END
